entries.author: SYMEON THESSALONICENSIS ARCHIEPISCOPUS
entries.title: Marci Eugenici, metropolitae Ephesi, Expositio ordinis liturgiae ecclesiasticae
entries.note: Elenchus parenthetical: 'Sequebatur in editione Iassensi Marci Eugenici ... Expositio ordinis liturgiae ecclesiasticae, quam invenies inter Ephesii scripta a nobis edita in tomo CLI.' No column given.

problems: Page-number OCR is weak in cols 23-33 (headers read '21 ... 23', '$90'); the Opera/title and the two Dosithei prefaces (Elenchus 25 and 29) could not be pinned exactly. Body 23 (title) and 25 (first preface) are best readings, not settled.
De sacris ordinationibus has no title block in the OCR (dialogue continues across the work boundary); bodyCol 361 rests on the running head and the Elenchus.

The Dialogus contra omnes haereses (cols 33-~830 in Ordo: Prologus, cap. I-CCCLXXX) is Symeon's single Dialogue; the Elenchus splits it into De sacramentis ... De ordine sepulturae. The Ordo lists chapters, not top-level pieces, so no 'parts' were built.

The Ordo has no top-level work absent from the Elenchus; all its heads fall inside listed entries. Dosithei's Nuncupatoria and Praefatio ad lectorem are both under the one Elenchus entry. Not entered: running Notitia/Monitum matter inside entries.
